Healthcare Staff Augmentation

Coverage for the Gaps That Don't Wait for a Hiring Cycle

A biller goes on leave, a coder resigns mid-audit, or claim volume spikes faster than your team can absorb, and suddenly the gap isn't theoretical, it's today's backlog. Staff augmentation places trained billing, coding and administrative professionals directly into your existing workflow, on a timeline measured in days, not the months a full hiring cycle usually takes.

This is different from PMEX's fully managed billing or coding services. Staff augmentation places people who work inside your systems, under your processes, reporting the way your own staff would, rather than moving the whole function off-site. It's built for practices that like their current setup and just need more hands, not a new system.

PMEX supplies billers, coders, virtual medical assistants and administrative staff who are already trained on medical billing fundamentals, then ramps them up quickly on your specific specialty, payers and software.

When This Makes Sense

Common Triggers for Bringing in Extra Hands

Unexpected Staff Turnover

A biller or coder leaves and the workload doesn't wait for a replacement search.

Seasonal Volume Spikes

Flu season, open enrollment or a new provider joining drives claim volume up temporarily.

A Growing Backlog

Denials or A/R have piled up faster than the current team can work them.

A New Location Opening

A new site needs front-office and billing coverage before local hiring is complete.

A Large Credentialing Push

Multiple providers need enrollment at once, beyond what the in-house team can absorb.

Testing Before Committing

A practice wants extra capacity without committing to a permanent hire right away.
